Text: On a visit to {System}, your ship detects a considerable power source, cleverly disguised within the natural activity of a moon

Map data marks the moon as uninhabited and irrelevant. Could {SystemRuler} be hiding something nefarious? 

You return with a tech team and full security contingent.
It looks like nobody has been inside this warehouse for centuries

Powered by a small fission reactor, the hall is filled by endless racks of pre-Collapse servers. 

"Lets see if we can learn what this massive server cluster is for," mutters {d(TechHead)} as {he(TechHead)} powers up a small workstation.
Doctor K's Log #3

"I expected the simulation start-up process to be quite lengthy, but with only 5 human brains, 12 years seems excessive for this database of human experience.

"The League's mishandling of galactic affairs will bring about civil war in 4 years at most, and NovaCorp's latest inventions may yet accidentally destroy us..."
Detailed documentation helps {d(TechHead)} understand the project

"There's a curious cyclical pattern to the logs: each loop features only minor differences from the last. I wonder whether this is part of the doctor's design? 

"Interfacing with the system will give you access to one of the simulated experiences. Do you want to try it?"  

You give the go-ahead.
Accessed a experience from the past
The lights shuffle psychedelically; {D(TechHead)} fades away; you are one with everything

You open your eyes. You are {PlayerCharacter} and you regret it. Everything is ablaze; the heat reminds you of hell. Have you been there before?

Heavy rain does nothing to stop the burning sensation. Not raindrops, teardrops. The cries of the deceived torture you.

There's no running away, only pain and suffering.
Haunted by pre-collapse experiences
"Are you ok?"

The panic in {d_s(TechHead)} voice snaps you back to reality. It takes a second to get your bearings but you reassure everyone that you've suffered no physiological trauma...

"The system has collapsed, the servers are completely fried!" {he(TechHead)} exclaims.

You nod, as you wonder about psychological damage...

You are Tania Cavalcanti, a renowed architect from Earth. Day after day you theorise: how could one design a fully functional ringworld?

The failure of your first attempt haunts you to this day. You will atone for it, even if it takes you an eternity.
The experience has enriched you, but the suffering of their simulated mind is a heavy burden

They think they are real, maybe they are...

A message flashes on the main console. "Experiences available: {showVar(PlayerCharacter, "CoE.ExperienceCount")}"

"Is it still operational?" you ask.
"Successful interface rate estimated at 85%, it's your call."
I have to go in again!

These people have had enough, begin the shutdown procedures
{D(TechHead)} runs a shutdown procedure outlined in the documentation

The change in the output logs is immediate: something different is happening to the simulated minds inside. After the first day, it is obvious the cycle has been broken. 

After 42 hours, the system finally shuts down. The last few logs are a plaintext message in standard language:

"We know the truth now. We were living a lie. We are now free. THANK YOU."
"Successful interface rate has fallen to 70%. Still interested?"
"I cannot predict the success rate anymore. Use it at your own risk!"
